pages.title: Role
pages.text: The Void Resonance Box is a processing block for void fragments and resonance materials. It keeps crafting, status feedback, and output handling in one place.

pages.title: How It Works
pages.text: Insert the input item and catalyst, and the machine will automatically resolve the recipe and begin processing. If the output slot can accept more, it keeps producing results; otherwise it pauses and reports its current state.

pages.title: Recipe Notes
pages.text: Recipes are maintained through data generation, which makes balancing and future updates much easier. When the material set changes, you only need to update the generated data.

pages.title: Layout Advice
pages.text: For a machine like this, a clear UI matters most: separate input, catalyst, output, and status areas so players can tell the machine state at a glance.
